title: Classic British Bangers and Mash
description: A hearty and comforting traditional British dish made with sausages and mashed potatoes. Perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Boil the potatoes in a large pot of salted water until tender, about 15-20 minutes.
While the potatoes are cooking, cook the sausages in a large skillet over medium-high heat, browning on all sides, until cooked through.
Drain the potatoes and mash with butter, salt, and pepper.
In the same skillet, add flour to make a roux, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Gradually add milk, whisking constantly, to make a smooth gravy.
Simmer the gravy over low heat until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Serve the sausages on top of the mashed potatoes, spooning the gooey gravy over the top.
